display_title: There Are Wolves in That Bathhouse
description:
Dan-O grew up seeing strange, inhuman things since childhood. Incidents and accidents constantly occur around him, leading to constant layoffs from his part-time jobs. This time, after receiving his layoff notice, Dan-O, now penniless and frustrated, is visited by someone who tells him to "go to Wolhae Village and claim his inheritance." Dan-O inherits a bathhouse nestled atop a mountain. But not only does he inherit Dan-O Bathhouse, he also inherits two handsome men he's never met before?! Cheong and Hyeon act as if Dan-O has always owned this place, and it's their destiny, and this only makes things more suspicious...

Dan-O Bathhouse, a place with a mysterious aura that only spirits visit! The long-standing bond between three men continues here.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
